text:
Assistant A gives the actual results: for each month it lists the highest and lowest closing prices, and the values are correct (January 156.25/153.80, February 163.90/161.80, March 168.20/166.80). It does not include a header row, and it puts the data in a plain-text block, but it follows the CSV format with one line per month.

Assistant B only has an introductory sentence and no data, so it doesn't answer the question.

A is clearly better.

[[A]]
